notes.decision: Translated 'Fathers' — Lyc. plural of ⲉⲓⲱⲧ/ⲓⲱⲧ 'father.' The chapter that follows (lines 25-end) systematically identifies each major divine emanation (Father of Lights, Mother of Life, Third Ambassador, Beloved of Lights, First Man) as the 'beginning' (ⲁⲣⲭⲏ) of a class of gifts/blessings/counsels/honors. 'Fathers of the Light who are joined to one another' captures this genealogical-emanative system. Alternative reading 'eyes' (= ⲃⲁⲗ) is less coherent with the chapter's content.
'Joined to one another' — qualitative form, possibly from ⲱⲃⲁ/ⲧⲱⲃⲉ 'mix, attach.' In the genealogical-emanative reading, the Fathers are 'joined' (linked in succession) rather than 'mixed.'
Lyc. ⲱⲱⲡⲉ = ϣⲱⲡⲉ 'become.' The construction is a polite imperative: 'become (in the state of) you knowing' = 'be it known to you.' Mani addressing his disciples.

'The foremost of the Holy Spirit' — apposition identifying the Mother of Life with the highest emanation associated with the Holy Spirit. ⲡⲱⲁⲣⲡ here means 'the first/foremost one' (substantive) rather than the title 'First Man.'

'Watchers and hunters' — ⲛⲟ̄ⲉⲣⲉⲟ̄ⲉ tentatively from ⲟⲩⲣⲏ/ⲱⲣϫ̄ 'guard, watcher' (Lyc. plural with vowel reduplication); ⲕⲩⲛⲏⲅⲟⲥ = Greek κυνηγός 'hunter.' The pairing of guards/hunters as classes whose 'beginning' is the First Man fits the Manichaean cosmological hierarchy.

Translated 'who has poured forth his five Sons.' The verb ⲥⲱⲣ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ('scatter/pour forth') is the cosmogonic verb for the Living Spirit's emanative diffusion of his five Sons (the Five Sons of the Living Spirit = the cosmic architects). Preserves the diffusive imagery.
'The Great Builder who is glorified.' ⲛⲁⲃ = ⲛⲟϭ (great); ⲛⲉⲕⲱⲧ = ⲕⲱⲧ ('builder'); ⲉⲧⲟ ⲛ̄ⲉⲁⲩ = qualitative + ⲉⲁⲩ ('glory'), idiomatic 'is glorified/glorious.' Word ⲉⲁⲩ is split across lines 3-4.

'The unique upholder.' ⲥⲟⲩⲓⲧ from ⲥⲟⲩⲱⲧ ('single, unique'). ⲥⲱϩ here taken as related to ⲥⲱⲱϩⲉ ('stand erect, support'), giving 'unique upholder' — fits the function of the lead Omophoros bearing the cosmos. Confidence moderate; alternative readings could include 'unique gathering/assembly.'

'He who looses to raise those who are bound.' ⲃⲱⲗ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ = release; ⲧⲟⲩⲱ = raise (per mandatory glossary, preserve vertical-soteriological semantics); ⲏⲓⲧ = bound (qualitative of ⲱⲗ/ⲏⲗ?). The pair release+raise matches the soteriological doublet documented in vocab.

'The gatherer-to-recognition of those scattered forth.' ⲣⲉϩⲥⲱⲩⲥ = ⲣⲉϥ-ⲥⲱⲟⲩϩⲥ ('one who gathers'); ⲁⲥⲟⲩⲛ taken as 'into recognition' (ⲁ + ⲥⲟⲩⲛ̄). Mind of Light gathers scattered light back into cognition.

Tentatively rendered 'the eye is not blinded.' ⲡⲓⲉⲥⲟ unclear — possibly 'the eye/sight' given the parallel ⲛⲓⲁⲧⲉ ('eyes') in next line; ⲁⲃⲁⲓⲗⲉ taken as related to ⲃⲗⲗⲉ ('be blind'). The whole phrase reads as a description of him whose perception remains undimmed regarding the knowledge of the eyes. Confidence low.
'Established firm in him.' ⲧⲁⲭⲣⲟ = strengthen/establish; ⲛⲥⲏⲧϩ = Lyc ⲛϩⲏⲧϥ 'in him.' Continues the description of him in whom the eye is not blinded.

Tentatively 'open them eight-fold out from their grip.' ϩⲙⲟⲩⲛ = 'eight' (number) seems most attested reading; ⲡⲟⲩⲛⲁⲥⲧⲉ = 'their grip/teeth' from ⲛⲁϣⲧ-/ⲛⲁϫϩ-, fitting the eschatological release of souls from the dark powers' jaws. Confidence low; the precise sense of 'eight-fold' is unclear in Manichaean cosmological context.
